name: Downhill Beachhouse
stayType: Hostel in a restored Victorian house
accommodation: 6 double rooms plus one 4-bed and two 7-bed dorms; exclusive use for groups
suitableFor: Families, couples, solo travellers and groups
confirmedFeatures: Wetsuit and bodyboard rental, self-catering kitchen, sea-view lounges, laundry, garden with BBQ, group catering on request
overview: A restored Victorian house on the beach at Downhill, below Mussenden Temple, run as a hostel with six double rooms and three dormitories. Guests share a kitchen, laundry and lounges overlooking the ocean, and there is a garden with picnic and barbecue areas. It rents wetsuits and bodyboards, is open all year and takes exclusive-use group bookings.
surfTripFit: It sits on the beach and rents out wetsuits and bodyboards, so it is one of the most surf-focused places to stay on this stretch of coast.
